messages.subject: new datatable issue
parts:
Hello -- I am trying to replace the datatable element in my Shiny app with the DT::datatable element using the information on this page  http://rstudio.github.io/DT/.

shiny 0.11.1  (release candidate)  /  DT  0.0.8   [both from github]

The code shown below works as expected with the old datatable.  Use the dropdown to select a dataset and the screen is updated correctly.  Now, uncomment the DT lines and comment the old datatable lines.  When you use the drop down to change the dataset a warning message box appears.  And the datasets are written one below the other.

============app.R=============================
require(shiny)
#require(DT)

server <- function(input, output) {   
    dataset <- reactive({ d <- if(input$dataset=="mtcars") mtcars else iris; d })
    #output$tbl = DT::renderDataTable({ DT::datatable(dataset()) })
    output$tbl = renderDataTable({ dataset() })
}

ui <- shinyUI(
    navbarPage("Example",
        tabPanel("DataTable",
            selectInput("dataset", label=h6("Dataset"), choices=c("mtcars","iris"), selected="mtcars", multiple=FALSE),
            #DT::dataTableOutput('tbl')
            dataTableOutput('tbl')
        )
    )
)

shinyApp(ui=ui, server=server)
=============================================

Is this a bug or do I need to set something else?  Thanks.
